scripts.build: pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.zip: pnpm run clean && pnpm run zip:chrome && pnpm run zip:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: pnpm run build:chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -r -FS ../montarapass-chrome.zip . -x "*.git*" "node_modules/*"
scripts.zip:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -r -FS ../montarapass-firefox.zip . -x "*.git*" "node_modules/*"
